svg.title: The life of a slice
svg.desc: The states are the ones the machine derives from files, not the planner's opinion.
svg.text: The states are the ones the machine derives from files, not the planner's opinion.
02/07 The agent works in its pane.
03/07 It stops: the exit file is written last.
SCENARIO 2/3 · A RED GATE, ONE REPAIR
04/07 FAIL: a file outside the perimeter.
05/07 One repair, fed with the verdict.
03/04 The pane is gone: a report but no exit.
04/04 The planner drops it; its files are free.
